newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-Ireland's Branagan called-up for Wales game.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Ireland's Branagan called-up for Wales game.

text.p: Bolton Wanderers goalkeeper Keith Branagan was on Tuesday added to the Republic of Ireland squad for the friendly international against Wales in Cardiff on February 11.
Branagan, 30, won a "B' international cap against England two years ago but has yet to make his Ireland senior debut.
He replaces Blackburn Rovers goalkeeper Shay Given who was forced out of the squad on Monday because of a stomach strain.
